  • Method Details

    • add

      public void add(Long idUser1, Long idUser2)
      Creates and saves a new friendship between two users
      Parameters:
      idUser1 - the ID of the first user
      idUser2 - the ID of the second user
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if the users are the same or IDs are null
      RepositoryException - if the friendship already exists

    • remove

      public void remove(Tuple<Long,Long> id)
      Removes an existing friendship from the network
      Parameters:
      id - a Tuple containing the IDs of the two friends
      Throws:
      RepositoryException - if the friendship does not exist

    • findAll

      public List<Friendship> findAll()
      Retrieves all users currently registered in the network, sorted by id
      Returns:
      a list containing all users, sorted by id
      Throws:
      EmptyListException - if there are no users in the network

    • findAll

      public List<Friendship> findAll(Predicate<Friendship> filter)
      Retrieves the friendships that satisfy the given condition. Unlike findAll(), it does not throw if the result is empty.
      Parameters:
      filter - the condition a friendship must satisfy to be included
      Returns:
      a list with the matching friendships, possibly empty

    • stream

      public Stream<Friendship> stream()
      Returns a new stream over all friendships, for further processing by other services. Unlike findAll(), it does not throw if there are no friendships.
      Returns:
      a new stream of all friendships, possibly empty; it can be consumed only once

    • getFriendsId

      public Set<Long> getFriendsId(Long userId)
      Returns the identifiers of all friends of the given user.
      Parameters:
      userId - the identifier of the user
      Returns:
      the set of ids of the users who are friends with userId, possibly empty
